name: Green Goddess
sensory: Bright ceremonial matcha folded into pistachio and coconut cream, softened with oat milk and vanilla bean. A drizzle of local honey and a pinch of sea salt keep every sip round, green and quietly luxurious.
addOnNote: Optional CBD add-on available where permitted.

name: Purp Drink
sensory: Earthy ube and a whisper of lavender layered over smooth matcha. Nutty, floral and gently sweet — the purple pour everyone photographs first.
imageAlt: Purp Drink, a layered purple ube and lavender matcha

name: Gold Drip
sensory: Espresso shaken until silky, finished with a golden crema and a deep, toasty close. All the ceremony of an espresso martini, poured as a latte — zero proof.
imageAlt: Gold Drip, an espresso-martini-style latte with golden crema

name: Pink Velvet
sensory: Ripe strawberry and vanilla cream meet a layer of bright matcha. Sweet, plush and a little playful — dessert, dressed for the evening.
imageAlt: Pink Velvet, strawberry and vanilla layered with matcha

name: Green Mile
sensory: Twice the matcha, poured ultra-creamy. Deep, grassy and plush from the first sip to the last — the one regulars order quietly.
imageAlt: Green Mile, a deep green double-matcha with thick cream
